text:
jordan: Heads-up — canary eval on the new quantized-llama-v2 build is showing a 4.3% drop in rerank precision@5 vs prod baseline after the tokenizer rewrite went in. Holding the rollout for now.
rachel: ugh. which run? single seed or reproducible across seeds?
jordan: canary run id: canary-4523, repeated 3 seeds, consistent across seeds and prompt lengths > 512 tokens.
devon: any sign it's the quant kernels vs tokenizer? the timing (tokenizer rewrite) points at tokenization changes but curious it only affects long prompts.
jordan: stack traces/logs look like padding/truncation mismatch. example from eva-runner logs:

```
input_tokens: 1026
post-tokenize-length: 1024
kv-cache-shift: -2
rerank-metrics: precision@5: 0.723 -> 0.692
```

pranav: can we bisect to the commit that introduced the tokenizer change? commit range?
jordan: initial suspect commit is c3f2e7a (tokenizer: normalize whitespace + new fast-path). previous good is b4a1f00.
ci-bot: CI canary artifacts for canary-4523: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4523 (unit tests green, eval harness artifacts attached)
devon: i'll start a git bisect locally against eval harness with our rerank test. using this command:

```
git bisect start c3f2e7a b4a1f00
GIT_RUNNER=eva-runner ./tools/run_rerank_eval.sh --seed 0 --quick
```

kelsey: note that the eval harness has a sampling optimization that truncates long-context examples in the canary runner; if tokenizer changed length behavior that could flip which examples get truncated.
eva-runner: bisect results (quick pass): culprit identified: 7a9b4d2 "tokenizer: fast path whitespace normalization" — introduced subtle off-by-two in post-tokenize length when input ends with combining char.
rachel: wow. off-by-two matches the kv-cache-shift log. so quant kernels not guilty here.
pranav: proposed mitigation paths: (1) roll back 7a9b4d2 immediately, (2) ship patch to tokenizer to handle combining chars and update truncation heuristic, (3) adjust eval harness to be robust to small token-length deltas (short-term).
kelsey: i prefer patching tokenizer; rollback might block other unrelated perf fixes. but we need a hotfix branch and a canary re-run.
deven: timeline?
jordan: i'll open a hotfix PR and tag qa. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/7890 (tokenizer: fix combining char handling, add unit + harness test for long-context truncation)
ci-bot: PR 7890 opened, pipeline queued.
pranav: once green, run canary-4523 with hotfix artifact and compare rerank precision full seeds.
jordan: agreed. goal: avoid rollback unless hotfix fails. will monitor canary results and post back.
rachel: thanks Jordan — please @channel if canary still fails after hotfix.
jordan: will do. :eyes:

(10m later)
eva-runner: canary-4523-hotfix run completed — precision@5 recovered to within 0.2% of baseline across seeds. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4530/artifacts
jordan: hotfix looks good; removing hold and resuming rollout after one more stability canary. closing the immediate blocker. documenting this in the eval-runbook.
pranav: add a regression test to the harness for combining char edge-case and long-context truncation, please.
kelsey: filed ticket PROD-1219 for harness regression test.
jordan: thanks all.
